name: Invalid Entanglement Target
hint: An entanglement operation needs a different actor that exists in the project. Entangling a sprite with itself or naming an absent actor leaves the relationship undefined and can prevent the intended quantum behavior.
instruction: Select another existing sprite or a supported Stage target, and verify that its name matches an actor in the project before running the entanglement operation.
